title: TalkBack MCP get_session_action_items tool result (v1)
description: Structured output of tools/call for tool name get_session_action_items (and alias get_action_items). v1: ephemeral on-read items only; not persisted. See docs/mcp-session-action-items-schema.md.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump when adding required fields or breaking semantics.

action_items.description: Ephemeral action items; empty when none or low-signal.

description.description: Short next step grounded in session content.

owner.description: Optional assignee when explicitly stated in content; omit when unknown.

low_signal.description: True when content is weak or missing for reliable extraction.

note.description: Optional diagnostic message (e.g. no indexed chunks).

llm_model.description: Optional model id when an LLM extraction ran.
